capsule-api.name: CircuitBreaker
capsule-api.description:
High-performance lockfree circuit breaker using DualAtomicU64 pattern. Implements fault isolation with automatic recovery detection.
**Key Characteristics**: - 9 packed fields in 8 bytes (DualAtomicU64 bit-packing) - 9.8ns load latency (single atomic operation) - <15ns update latency (atomic CAS with generation counter) - SWeMR pattern for concurrent access (single writer, multiple readers) - Q8.8 fixed-point metrics for deterministic calculations
**Use Cases**: - Service mesh fault isolation - Database connection management - External API call protection - Microservice cascade failure prevention

type-parameters.note: CircuitBreaker is a concrete type (not generic)

memory-layout.field: Packed state: state(3 bits) + failure_count(16 bits) + success_count(16 bits) + threshold(8 bits) + recovery_threshold(8 bits) + generation(13 bits)
Packed timing: last_failure_ts(32 bits) + timeout_ms(16 bits) + half_open_count(8 bits) + consecutive_failures(8 bits)
Cache line padding to prevent false sharing (64B alignment)

constructor.name: new
constructor.signature: pub const fn new(config: CircuitBreakerConfig) -> Self
constructor.description: Creates a new circuit breaker with specified configuration

postconditions.condition: Circuit breaker is in Closed state

constructor.name: default
constructor.description: Creates circuit breaker with default configuration (5 failures, 3 successes, 30s timeout)

method.name: state
method.description: Returns current circuit breaker state (Closed, Open, or HalfOpen)

postconditions.condition: Returns one of: Closed, Open, HalfOpen

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns true if circuit is open (failing fast)

method.name: is_closed
method.description: Returns true if circuit is closed (normal operation)

method.name: metrics
method.description: Returns snapshot of all circuit breaker metrics
method.returns: CircuitMetrics { failure_count: u16, success_count: u16, state: CircuitState, half_open_count: u8, consecutive_failures: u8, generation: u16 }

postconditions.condition: Returns failures since last reset or state transition

method.name: success_count
method.description: Returns current success count (relevant in HalfOpen state)

postconditions.condition: Returns successes since entering HalfOpen state

method.name: record_success
method.description: Records a successful operation, potentially transitioning HalfOpen to Closed

preconditions.condition: Ideally single writer (concurrent writes retry via CAS)

postconditions.condition: If HalfOpen and success_count >= success_threshold: transition to Closed
Generation counter incremented on state transition

method.name: record_failure
method.description: Records a failed operation, potentially transitioning Closed to Open or HalfOpen to Open

postconditions.condition: If Closed and failure_count >= failure_threshold: transition to Open
If HalfOpen: immediately transition to Open

method.name: reset
method.description: Manually resets circuit breaker to Closed state

method.name: try_acquire
method.description: Attempts to acquire permission to execute protected operation

postconditions.condition: If Open and timeout elapsed: transitions to HalfOpen, returns Ok(())
If Open and timeout not elapsed: returns Err(CircuitError::Open)
If HalfOpen: returns Ok(()) for limited probes

method.returns: Ok(()) - permission granted, proceed with operation Err(CircuitError::Open) - circuit is open, fail fast

method.name: try_call
method.signature: pub fn try_call<F, T, E>(&self, f: F) -> Result<T, CircuitError<E>> where F: FnOnce() -> Result<T, E>
method.description: Executes function with circuit breaker protection (acquire + call + record)

preconditions.condition: f is Send if called from multiple threads

postconditions.condition: If f() returns Ok: record_success() called, returns Ok(T)
If f() returns Err: record_failure() called, returns Err(CircuitError::Inner(E))

method.name: snapshot
method.description: Captures atomic consistent snapshot of all circuit breaker state

postconditions.condition: Returns consistent view of all state at single point in time

method.returns: CircuitSnapshot { state, failure_count, success_count, generation, last_failure_ts, timeout_ms, half_open_count, consecutive_failures }

state-transitions.description: Circuit breaker implements standard 3-state machine with timeout-based recovery

states.state: Normal operation, allowing all calls. Failures increment counter.
Failing fast, rejecting all calls. Timeout timer running.
Testing recovery, allowing limited probe calls.

transitions.transition: Service is unhealthy, start failing fast to allow recovery
Timeout expired, allow probe calls to test recovery
Administrative override to restore normal operation

input.description: Receives health signals from load balancer

output.description: Emits state transition events for monitoring
Provides circuit state for rate limiting decisions

invariants.invariant: State is always one of: Closed (0), Open (1), HalfOpen (2)
Generation counter increases monotonically on every state transition
All operations are wait-free or lock-free (no blocking)
Snapshot is always consistent (no torn reads due to DualAtomicU64)

assum-tags.description: Safety assumptions and verifications per ASSUM framework

assume.text: DualAtomicU64 provides consistent 128-bit snapshots via two ordered 64-bit loads

verify.text: T28 concurrent tests verify no torn reads under 1000-thread contention

assume.text: Generation counter prevents ABA problem in state transitions
assume.location: fn record_success(), fn record_failure(), fn reset()

verify.text: Property tests verify generation monotonicity under concurrent access

assume.text: 64-byte cache alignment prevents false sharing between circuit breakers
No panics in any public method (saturating arithmetic, bounded state values)

verify.text: No unwrap/expect in production code, only saturating_add for counters

assume.text: State transitions are deterministic given same input sequence

verify.text: T28 Q29-Q35 determinism tests verify reproducible behavior

claims.claim: Lockfree atomic operations vs lock acquisition overhead
